verdict.rationale: Versioning, review, and rollback of automations or configurations is a fair axis for a feature-flag and experimentation platform like Statsig, so the story applies. The evidence pack has nothing on version history, change review or approvals, or rollback. The Console API (CRUD) and real-time gate toggling are building blocks or adjacent features, not documented versioning or rollback of automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
